headline: Bitcoin Rally Stalls Below $100,000 Amid Profit-Taking and Tech Weakness
summary: Bitcoin's advance toward $100,000 has encountered heavy selling pressure driven by profit-taking, macroeconomic uncertainty, and broader weakness across technology shares.
why: Bitcoin is the benchmark cryptocurrency, and its price action frequently reflects speculative liquidity and institutional risk appetite.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Selling volume around round-number resistance and tech equity weakness have halted the upward momentum.
